framework.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI Applications
framework.description: Authoritative OWASP security risk taxonomy for autonomous AI agents, tool-calling workflows, and multi-agent architectures.

controls.title: Agent Goal Hijacking
controls.description: Adversarial manipulation of an autonomous agent's planning state, objective hierarchy, or sub-goal decomposition via direct prompts or untrusted external context.

controls.title: Tool Misuse and Parameter Manipulation
controls.description: Inducing an AI agent to invoke unauthorized tools or inject malicious/escalated arguments into structured tool calls due to missing server-side schema and authorization enforcement.

controls.title: Identity and Privilege Compromise
controls.description: Execution of agent tools using over-privileged static service accounts rather than scoped, per-user delegated credentials (confused deputy escalation).

controls.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
controls.description: Injection of malicious state or instructions into an agent's short-term working context, episodic memory, or shared RAG retrieval store to persist compromise across sessions.

controls.title: Cascading Hallucination and Reasoning Loops
controls.description: Compounding reasoning errors or unbounded planning iterations across multi-step agent loops that lead to runaway resource exhaustion or unintended tool execution.

controls.title: Uncontrolled Code and Sandboxed Execution
controls.description: Allowing agents to generate and execute arbitrary code, SQL queries, or shell commands without strict sandboxing, AST validation, and network egress controls.

controls.title: Multi-Agent Communication Spoofing
controls.description: Lack of cryptographic authentication and schema validation on inter-agent messages, enabling a compromised sub-agent to hijack peer orchestrators.

controls.title: Agentic Supply Chain and Tool Schema Integrity
controls.description: Ingesting unverified third-party MCP servers, OpenAPI tool specs, or loose JSON parameter schemas ('additionalProperties: true') that introduce untrusted instructions or parameter injection vectors.

controls.title: Insufficient Human-in-the-Loop Oversight
controls.description: Absence of mandatory human approval gates before an autonomous agent executes state-mutating, financial, or cross-tenant privileged tool actions.

controls.title: Auditability and Telemetry Failures
controls.description: Failure to log immutable, correlation-tagged traces of agent reasoning steps, retrieved chunks, and tool call arguments for forensic verification.
